rules.text: A refund is possible within 30 days of delivery, counted from the delivery date in the customer's time zone. A lost parcel (status lost, past its promisedBy date) has no window: it is refunded in full, shipping included.
Final-sale items are never refunded. A damaged final-sale item can be replaced.
An opened item gets a partial refund of 80% of its price, unless it arrived damaged.
Shipping costs are refunded only when the order arrived late (after promisedBy), arrived damaged, or was lost.
Each order item is refunded at most once.
A refund never exceeds what the customer paid for the order, minus earlier refunds.

approvals: A refund of €50 or less needs no approval.
Above €200, the support lead and finance both approve.
A rejected approval means no refund: the ticket moves to rejected.
